events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Tutorial: Out Of Orders

options.text: I'll be able to Order more people around next year!

events.text: You've run out of Orders! Your [unit] can't act if you don't have an Orders to command it. You'll get more Orders at the start of your next turn, but if you need, you can spend int(TRAINING_PER_ORDER) Training to get a new Orders. The most important source of Orders is Legitimacy.
